_description: Source of truth for each agent's configuration files, as detection and packaging actually treat them. 'restored_by' names the classes in lib/tooling.js that vendor and redeploy each artifact, and test/install.test.js fails if this map and that contract drift.

pi.extensions: ~/.pi/agent/extensions/ (loose .ts files and package directories), listed in settings.json -> extensions array
pi.packages: settings.json -> packages array; local packages live in ~/.agents/packages/<name>

claude_code.hooks: ~/.claude/settings.json -> hooks key; ~/.claude/hooks/ holds plugin-owned hook directories

not_restored.claudeAgents: employer-internal agent definitions stay archived, not published
not_restored.claudePlugins: plugin installs and registries are third-party state, rebuilt by reinstalling the plugins
not_restored.claudeHooks: hook directories belong to third-party plugins; this package registers its own hooks from shared-core/hooks/hooks.json

pluginsOwnership: cache and marketplaces hold third-party plugin content — archived and restorable, never published
installed_plugins.json and known_marketplaces.json are personal state: which plugins *I* enabled

shared_state.packaged_tooling: shared-core/tooling/ (see shared-core/tooling/policy.json for what ships and why the rest does not)
